title: CandidateIdentity
description: The frozen identity tuple (P1-FINAL §12). candidate_id is opaque and derived; no SQLite row number appears in any public contract.

candidate_id.description: Opaque, deterministic, derived from source_sha256 + index_version + source_record_ref. A model may select one but cannot construct one that verifies.

source_record_ref.description: Structured locator resolving to exactly one complete normalized record. Optional @mode suffix for mode-bearing records.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the authoritative curated source. Mismatch means re-resolve, never remap.

index_version.description: Derived-index format version. Mismatch means rebuild the index.
